summary: End-to-end frontend verification of all 9 requested fixes for the Mahaveer Hospital Laravel CMS. All 9 items PASS. Verified via Playwright on preview URL at desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844).
critical_code_review_comments: Hero form: Doctor <select data-testid='appt-doctor'> populated dynamically with 5 admin-managed doctors (Dr. Amardeep, Dr. Sunita Sharma, Dr. Rakesh Kumar, Dr. Anjali Verma, Dr. Vinay Singh). District field removed as required.
Mobile date picker (data-testid='appt-date-visible'): visible with valid bounding box (43,397,303x50) and opens flatpickr calendar on tap on 390x844 viewport. Future date pickable.

End-to-end booking flow verified: submitted TEST_UI_1787067024 (name/phone/village=TestVillage/doctor=Dr. Sunita Sharma/date=23 Aug 2026). Success message 'Booking received! We'll call you shortly to confirm.' displayed. Enquiry appears in /admin/enquiries with Preferred Doctor='Dr. Sunita Sharma' on detail page.

Featured doctor bio (data-testid='doctor-featured'): no literal '

' or '

' in visible inner_text — {!! description !!} unescaping confirmed rendering HTML properly.
Admin sidebar: no 'Translations' item under Settings. Confirmed groups: Overview / Website Content / Settings only.

Admin Enquiries list table headers: [Patient, Phone, Location, Appointment Date, Status, Received] — NO 'Source' column. Detail page fields: NAME/PHONE/EMAIL/VILLAGE/DISTRICT/PREFERRED DOCTOR/PREFERRED DATE/SUBJECT/MESSAGE — NO 'Source' field.

Website Settings color pickers: both swatch inputs (ws-primary-color, ws-accent-color) and hex inputs (ws-primary-color-hex, ws-accent-color-hex) are editable (not disabled/readonly). Save persisted #123456 → home page inline <style> shows '--c-primary: #123456' confirming theme applies site-wide.

Featured Videos: entering YouTube URL saved persistently, and public home renders '[data-testid=featured-videos-section]' with '[data-testid=featured-youtube]' anchor whose href matches the saved YouTube URL. Cleared URLs → section is removed from home (count=0).

Logo & favicon logic verified in blade templates (header.blade.php + layout.blade.php): `@if($siteSettings?->logo)` renders in header/footer; `@if($siteSettings?->favicon)` renders with cache-busted ?v=timestamp. Fallback SVG 'M+' mark used when no logo uploaded (current default state).
Restored defaults confirmed at end of run: primary_color=#3b1f4a, accent_color=#d64a3a, youtube_video_url='', instagram_video_url='' — home page CSS vars re-verified back to defaults.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_1787067024 enquiry via hero form (village=TestVillage, doctor=Dr. Sunita Sharma, date=23 Aug 2026). Left in DB as evidence of end-to-end flow. Website settings mutated then RESTORED to defaults (#3b1f4a / #d64a3a / empty video URLs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://website-theme-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. IMPORTANT selector gotcha: /admin/website-settings has TWO forms in DOM — the first form is the topbar logout form (action=/admin/logout). When saving settings via Playwright, DO NOT click page.locator('button[type=submit]').first — that will log you out. Instead use `form:has([data-testid="ws-primary-color"]) button[type=submit]` to target the settings form's Save button. Doctor <select> option values are doctor NAMES (as documented). Flatpickr uses 'appt-date-visible' for the visible input.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested fixes verified working end-to-end.
